title: Dataset v2 telemetry protocol
text: RootLens Dataset v2 uses 30-second PromQL windows sampled every 5 seconds. Each system window contains 12 services and seven features per service: CPU, memory, request rate, has-requests, latency milliseconds, error RPS, and error rate. Historical development incidents are controlled analogies, not proof of a live diagnosis.
